fields.subject: Model Mapping
fields.trigger: a MapAttributeMissingException is constructed with a ShardElement and the shard-key attribute's declared name
fields.response: record the element and name on the exception's Element and AttributeName properties and choose its message by element: ShardId says the shard attribute named a ShardId argument attribute that was not found and to remove the argument if there is no shard id parameter or column; RecordId says the named RecordId argument attribute was not found; ChildId says the ShardChild attribute's named child id attribute was not found; GrandChildId and GreatGrandChildId share one generic message saying the shard attribute's named child id attribute was not found
fields.postcondition: every message quotes the declared attribute name and tells the author to make it exactly match the mapping attribute's name; the GrandChildId and GreatGrandChildId messages do not say which of the two elements was missing, so a caller distinguishes them only through the Element property. The ShardId message exists but no library code path raises it, because a shard id's parameter is carried inside the shard-key mapping attribute itself
